mapper.select: SELECT id, name, cover_image, images, price, original_price, description, tags, specs, sort_order, status, stock, create_time, update_time FROM product WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, cover_image, images, price, original_price, description, tags, specs, sort_order, status, stock) VALUES (#{name}, #{coverImage}, #{images}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{description}, #{tags}, #{specs}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{stock})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock - #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
